The Process

From your first call to your first flight — handled

A four-step process built around your actual life — your spend, your goals, your dream trips. We handle everything. You just show up.

Book your discovery call →
Step 01

Discovery Call

A 30-minute call to review your spend, your existing points, and where you want to go. We map the gap between where you are and where you want to be. No homework. No obligation.

Step 02

Custom Card Strategy

We build a tailored card stack around how you actually spend — designed to earn 3–5x on every dollar instead of 1x. You apply for the right cards. We tell you which ones and in what order.

Step 03

Award Space & Booking Guide

We find the best available redemptions for your dream trip, walk you through every transfer on a live Google Meet or Loom, and guide you through the booking. You click the buttons — we're right there.

Step 04

You Travel Better

Walk into the business class lounge, board your flight, and enjoy. We stay in your corner for the next trip too — the strategy compounds over time.

The Problem

Why your points are worth far less than they should be

Credit card companies love when you redeem for cash back or travel portals. That's where they make their money. The real value is locked behind transfer partners, sweet spots, and award space — and finding it is a full-time job.

01

You're earning too few points per dollar

Most cardholders earn 1–1.5x per dollar on everyday purchases. With the right card stack, that number becomes 3–5x — without changing a single thing you buy. The difference, over a year, is tens of thousands of points.

02

You're redeeming them for a fraction of their value

Bank portals give you 1¢ per point. Those same points, transferred to the right airline partner and redeemed at a sweet spot, can deliver 4–6¢ per point. That's the difference between a coach ticket and a first-class suite.

03

You don't have time to figure it out yourself

Hundreds of transfer partners. Constantly-changing award charts. Limited availability windows. Finding a first-class Emirates redemption for two isn't just hard — it's a full-time job. We do it so you don't have to.

About Angelo

I opened my first travel card in 2015. I haven't paid for a flight since.

In 2015, I opened my first travel rewards credit card and discovered what most people never figure out: points, redeemed correctly, are worth far more than the banks want you to know. Since then I've redeemed over 8,000,000 points and unlocked more than $250,000 in luxury travel — for little more than taxes and fees.

Most recently I completed an around-the-world first-class trip for $800 in taxes. The retail cost was over $30,000. I've flown to the Maldives, Singapore, Bali, Frankfurt, and Thailand. All in premium cabins. All on points. And my credit score has never been better.

Paid With Points exists because I kept getting asked how. Now I work with a small group of clients at a time — doing it for them instead of just explaining how.

Common Questions

Everything before the call

For the Executive Concierge membership, we work with clients spending $5,000+ per month on personal or business credit cards. At that level the math is strongly in your favor — an optimized strategy can unlock $20,000–$60,000+ in annual travel value. If you spend less, our Skool platform (self-directed learning) is likely the better starting point.
Not necessarily — though adding one or two strategic cards typically makes a significant difference in earn rate. During your discovery call we'll review what you have and identify where you're leaving points on the table. Any card recommendations are always yours to accept or decline.
No — and when done correctly, the opposite is often true. I've maintained an excellent credit score while managing multiple cards for over a decade. We never recommend cards that don't fit your profile, and we always factor in your credit history when building a strategy.
If you already have points accumulated, we can often plan a significant trip within 3–6 months. Building from scratch with an optimized card strategy, most clients are positioned for a serious international trip within 12 months. We'll give you a realistic timeline on the discovery call based on your actual numbers.
We handle everything except the final click — and that's intentional. We find the award space, map out the transfer strategy, identify the right seats, and walk you through the exact steps on a call so you're the one placing the booking. Your loyalty account credentials and personal information stay entirely private. The complex part is never the booking itself — it's knowing what to book, when to transfer, and where to look. That's what we do.
We specialize in premium cabin redemptions — business and first class — using transfer partners and sweet spots that most people don't know exist. While a bank portal gives you 1¢ per point, we consistently achieve 4–5¢ or more. That difference is the entire value proposition. The around-the-world trip that cost $800 in taxes is worth $30,000 at retail. That's a 37x return on taxes paid.
The Executive Concierge membership is an annual engagement — pricing is discussed on the discovery call based on your spend level and goals. For context: most clients find it pays for itself many times over on the first trip alone. We only take clients where the value is clear. If it's not, we'll tell you that on the call.
That's often the best time to start. We'll map out exactly what you need, build a strategy around your timeline, and track progress toward your goal. Many clients take a smaller trip along the way while we build up to the big one.
It's a 30-minute conversation — no pitch deck, no pressure, no homework required beforehand. We look at your spend, your existing points, and your travel goals. By the end you'll have a realistic picture of what your points are worth and whether working together makes sense. Most people leave with something useful even if they don't become clients.
Yes — PWP Skool is a subscription community with weekly video tutorials, card strategy templates, transfer partner guides, and an open Q&A board. It's designed for people who want to learn the system themselves. If you'd rather have everything handled for you, the Executive Concierge membership is the right path.
